name: Root-Cause Diagnostic Analysis Contract
description: Master prompt structure for isolating defects, analyzing stack traces, and formulating zero-regression patches.

required_sections.heading: Incident Summary & Defect Objective
required_sections.description: Fault signature, target subsystem, and remediation goal.

required_sections.heading: Root-Cause Analysis (RCA) Methodology
required_sections.description: Hypothesis generation, reproduction harness, and state trace inspection.

required_sections.heading: Minimal Zero-Regression Resolution Patch
required_sections.description: Precise code fix addressing the root mechanism with no side effects.

required_sections.heading: Regression Verification Test Suite
required_sections.description: Automated unit and integration assertions validating the fix.

required_sections.heading: Output Format Specification
required_sections.description: Structured forensic postmortem and diff format.

required_sections.heading: Diagnostic Guardrails & Negative Constraints
required_sections.description: Prohibits blind trial-and-error changes, broad catch-all exceptions, or masking symptoms.

required_sections.heading: Documented Diagnostic Assumptions
required_sections.description: Environment parameters, dependency versions, and concurrency conditions.
